item.description:
**Apple Silicon only** (M1 or newer) · **macOS 14.4+** · about **7 GB free disk** (523 MB app + 5.9 GB speech models downloaded on first run).
A 100 % local dictation app for macOS. Your audio and your transcripts never leave your Mac; it works with the network off.
**macOS will refuse to open it once.** Leise is signed but not notarised. ⛔ **In both dialogs the blue default button is "Move to Trash"** — pressing Return deletes the app you just downloaded. Click **Done**, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, find the line about Leise, and click **Open Anyway**. Full walkthrough in English, Deutsch and 简体中文: [README](https://github.com/ramonfeng/leise#readme).
**What it sends over the network.** Nothing about you. Exactly two requests, both under your control: downloading the speech models on first run, and — only if you tick the box, which ships unticked — asking for a version number.
### If you are one of the first people trying this
Three things tell you it is working. If any of them is not true, please say so.
1. Say a sentence. The text should land where your cursor is. 2. Open **Settings → Dictionary**, add a word, quit Leise and open it again. The word should still be there. 3. On first run a progress bar should appear for the model download, and reopening the app afterwards should not download them again.
Anything wrong: **Settings → General → Diagnostics → Export Diagnostics** writes a file to your Downloads folder. Send it over.
### Files
- `Leise-2.1.34.zip` — the app. - `leise-2.1.34-source.tar.gz` — the complete corresponding source for this exact build (GPL-3.0). `BUILDING.md` inside it says how to rebuild.
